{{Top|leg}}
The '''TaggeCo. starport''' was a vacation center on the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]]-owned [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pallaxides]]. Consisting of dozens of landing pads, the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] also included a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]], [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]], recreation and sporting facilities. [[Spacers' Town]] was a small section of the port that catered to [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] crews on layover.<ref name="GTG">{{WEGCite|story=Gone To Ground|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
